about_company.about_short: Designs RF and microwave electronics for radar, electronic warfare, missiles, space and weather systems.
about_company.business_intro: Astra Microwave develops and manufactures radio-frequency and microwave components, subsystems and complete systems. Its customers include Indian defence agencies and public-sector manufacturers, ISRO, the India Meteorological Department and overseas OEMs; revenue comes from development programmes, production orders, exports and lifecycle services.
about_company.about_long: Astra works across radar, electronic warfare, missile electronics, telemetry, satellites, weather radar and hydrology. It designs its own GaN and GaAs microwave chips and builds higher-level subsystems and systems around them. Most revenue comes from government-linked defence, space and meteorology customers, with exports made directly and through its Astra Rafael Comsys joint venture and Singapore-based Aelius semiconductor business.

business_facts.title: Revenue mix
business_facts.text: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue was 80.4% defence, 7.7% space, 5.0% exports including deemed exports, 4.9% meteorology and 2.0% other work. Production orders contributed 93%, development 5%, AMC or service work 2%, and direct export orders were nil in the order-type view.

sources.label: Astra Microwave Q1 FY27 investor presentation

business_facts.title: Customer concentration
business_facts.text: On FY26 standalone revenue, DRDO contributed 28.2%, BEL and other defence PSUs 22.7%, IMD or the Meteorological Department 18.0%, exports through ARC and Aelius 11.9%, ISRO or SAC 6.4%, and private customers 3.0%.

sources.label: Astra Microwave Q1 FY27 investor presentation

business_facts.title: Order book
business_facts.text: The standalone order book was ₹2,156 crore at 30 June 2026. Defence and public-sector work represented 71.3%, space 26.3%, exports 2.0% and meteorology 0.4% of that quarter-end backlog; percentages are rounded.

sources.label: Astra Microwave Q1 FY27 investor presentation

business_facts.title: Engineering footprint
business_facts.text: The company reports four manufacturing facilities in Hyderabad, an R&D facility in Hyderabad and an R&D facility in Bengaluru. Its broader site table covers six operating locations with antenna ranges, environmental testing and RF test facilities.

sources.label: Astra Microwave Q1 FY27 investor presentation

business_facts.title: R&D and microwave chips
business_facts.text: Astra reports 701 R&D professionals, including nine doctorates, and more than 40 GaN and GaAs MMIC products operating up to 40 GHz. The chips support its radar, electronic-warfare, space and communications subsystems.

sources.label: Astra Microwave Q1 FY27 investor presentation

business_facts.title: Proposed demerger
business_facts.text: The board has given in-principle approval to separate the space, meteorology and hydrology undertakings. The structure, share-exchange ratio and other terms remained subject to reports, opinions and a final board decision at the time of the presentation.

sources.label: Astra Microwave Q1 FY27 investor presentation

what_changed.headline: A major radar win changed the scale of the backlog.
what_changed.text: The standalone order book was ₹2,156 crore at 30 June 2026. After a large July order, management said the current order book had risen to about ₹4,300 crore. This expands execution visibility, but it is an order-book step-up rather than revenue already recognised.
